html_inventory_repo_wide.note: Canonical companions live in companions/ (HTML = primary). duplicate_copies/diverged_stale are old build generations of the SAME companions. companions_dir_other_formats = downstream snapshots (PDF/PNG/Word) of a companion — attached to its parent by stem. unique_candidates = review: real new companion vs raw data-viewer. Repo-wide non-companion docs (111 PDFs under Zagentexecution/sap-skills = external SAC handbook; 19 xlsx = analysis workbooks; Transport_Intelligence/*.docx = a domain w/o an HTML companion) are NOT companions.
